title: Legal Environment of Arts Administration
description: Arts administrators work within arts and cultural, business, and legal environments. Students in this course will discuss legal issues that affect the arts, arts administrators, and arts and cultural organizations. Topics include rights, compliance, and contracts in and around contemporary arts organizations and arts communities. Students will analyze legal dilemmas for arts administrators and evaluate legal practices impacting arts administrators today.
prerequisites: Major status in Arts Administration and completion all 200- and 300- level AAD courses
